newsitem.title: USA: De Rigo nine-month sales fell to $133.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: De Rigo nine-month sales fell to $133.5 mln.

text.p: De Rigo Group said on Wednesday that its nine-month sales decreased 9.6 percent to $133.5 million from the same period last year.

The Italian sunglasses company said it posted $128.5 million in direct sales of frames compared with $139.2 million in sales last year, while other sales came to a total of $5 million compared with $8.6 million last year.
The company said the results are based on the exchange rate of $1.00 equal to Lira1551.4 for both the nine-month periods of 1995 and 1996.
